dateCheck: PIF Tower damage in Riyadh happened on Thursday 20 Nov, not Saturday.
A Houthi claim of a strike on the Al-Shuqaiq power station is unconfirmed.
No final COP31 text was agreed when this was drawn; talks were still in overtime.
Peru quake: 7:09 pm Friday local time is 00:09 UTC Saturday, so it counts as 21 Nov.

heroes.detail: Nearly 200 countries miss the deadline as fossil-fuel language and a $120bn adaptation target are cut from the draft. The EU warns: a good deal or no deal.
heroes.headline: COP31 stuck in overtime on day 13

heroes.detail: Saudi defences down three Houthi missiles over Riyadh; a drone is destroyed and the coalition hits Hodeidah and Sanaa.
heroes.headline: Three missiles downed over Riyadh

heroes.detail: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake strikes 34 km north of Junin, 108 km deep. It is felt in Lima, where residents rush into the streets. No deaths, no serious damage.
heroes.headline: M6.7 quake shakes the Andes
